title: Military Rehabilitation and Compensation Amendment (Veterans’ Healthcare Without Caps) Bill 2026
short_title: Military Rehabilitation and Compensation Amendment (Veterans’ Healthcare Without Caps) Bill 2026

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would prohibit monetary and numerical caps on specified veterans' treatment entitlements, including treatment for accepted injuries or diseases related to their service.
It would prevent limits based on individual treatment costs, cumulative spending within a period, or the number of times a treatment can be accessed.
The protections would cover existing and future entitlements from the day after Royal Assent, and would permit clinical appropriateness, safety and quality conditions.
changes: Treatment determinations under subsection 286(1) would have to comply with the new prohibition on caps.
The protection would extend to treatment entitlements under Part V of the Veterans' Entitlements Act 1986.
Regulations could bring additional treatment entitlements within the new protection.
summary.affected: Eligible veterans and practitioners providing their treatment are affected.
